title: CCGM Audit Finding
description: Schema for a single finding — one JSON object / one JSONL line in `.audit/current/findings.jsonl`. NOT SARIF; forward-compatible with a v2 SARIF emitter. Gate decision #30.

check_id.description: The check that produced this finding, e.g. `dm/unquoted-reserved-keyword`. Namespaced `<pack>/<check>`.

rule_id.description: The specific rule within the tool or LLM check that fired, e.g. `RF04` or `sql/reserved-keyword`.

severity.description: Consequence severity. Mechanically overwritten by the severity-rubric.json emitter for known check_ids; agent-reported value preserved in properties.agentReportedSeverity.

confidence.description: Signal precision. Separate axis from severity.

fix_confidence.description: Safety confidence for auto-fix, if applicable.

end_line.description: 1-based end line (inclusive). Omit for single-line findings.

message.description: Human-readable description of the finding. Secret values MUST be redacted before this field is written.

fingerprint.description: Stable baseline-matching key: sha256(lower(strip_all_whitespace(<primary_line ± 2 lines>)))[:16] + ':1', OR the tool's own partialFingerprint verbatim. Must not change when the file is reformatted.

source.description: Which runtime component emitted this finding: a deterministic spine tool or an LLM worker agent.

suppression.description: Present when this finding has been suppressed. Suppressed criticals still surface as [SUPPRESSED] in reports.

expires.description: ISO 8601 date after which the suppression should be re-reviewed, e.g. `2026-12-31`.

properties.description: Open bag for tool-specific or calibration metadata. Well-known keys: `agentReportedSeverity` (when rubric overwrote it), `owner` (CODEOWNERS entry), `package` (dep name for vuln findings).
